entities.name: Selçuk Bayraktaroğlu
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Selçuk Bayraktaroğlu is a Turkish general who has been the 32nd and current chief of the General Staff since 5 August 2025. He previously served as the 53rd commander of the Turkish Land Forces from August 2023 to August 2025.
